name: sitemap-url-extractor
title: Sitemap URL Extractor: Every URL of a Site for Audits
description: Get every URL of a site for an SEO or AI audit, or to feed a crawler. Finds sitemaps from robots.txt, follows indexes and .gz files, and returns each URL with lastmod, priority, hreflang and an optional HTTP status. Filter by regex or date. Export CSV, Excel or JSON, or use the API.
seoTitle: Sitemap URL Extractor: Get Every URL of a Site
seoDescription: Get every URL of a site for an SEO or AI audit, or to feed a crawler. Reads sitemaps, indexes and .gz files, with lastmod and optional HTTP status.
